assets.name: segment-lower
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Use the reference arm for design and metalwork. Show ONLY its LOWER cast-metal arm link as one disassembled solid component: a thick curved pierced link with a large round root bearing at one end, a round elbow bearing at the other, and a substantial side lug for a piston attachment. Dark cast iron and worn bronze bearing collars. Stand this single link upright on a small plain round maquette dais, supported at the root bearing by a short simple post. Complete isolated component, three-quarter studio view, light gray background, even lighting. Upper link, burner, pistons and the rest of the machine absent. No text.

assets.name: segment-upper
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Use the reference arm for design and metalwork. Show ONLY its UPPER cast-metal arm link as one disassembled solid component: an elongated gently curved pierced link, a large circular elbow bearing at its lower end, a smaller round burner-wrist bearing at the tip, and a solid piston attachment lug on its side. Dark cast iron and worn bronze collars. Stand the component diagonally upward on a small plain round maquette dais with a short support post attached to the elbow bearing. Complete isolated component, three-quarter studio view, light gray background, even lighting. Lower link, burner cup, pistons and carousel absent. No text.

assets.name: segment-burner
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Use the reference arm for design and metalwork. Show ONLY its burner head as one standalone solid module: a broad shallow bronze brazier cup with a perforated rim, thick iron underside, and short cylindrical mounting neck ending in a clear collar. Display upright on a small plain round maquette dais with a short support pin under the neck. Complete isolated component, three-quarter studio view slightly from above so the cup interior is visible, light gray background, even lighting. All arms and pistons absent. Unlit; no flame, smoke or text.

purpose: Standalone lower arm link, upper arm link and burner module staged on maquette daises for rough reconstruction and authored assembly.
assembly_authority: Images describe parts and attachment features; fitted pivots and linkage validity are authored later.
